identity.title: ALMA Reveals Transition of Polarization Pattern with Wavelength in HL Tau’s Disk

paper_type_evidence.quote: With the ALMA Cycle 4 program 2016.1.00162.S (PI: I. Stephens), we observed polarized emission toward HL Tau at 870 $\mu$m (Band 7) and at 1.3 mm (Band 6)

evidence.quote: Given a distance to HL Tau of $\sim$140 pc (cite: Rebull2004), the spatial resolution is 64, 42, and 55 au, respectively.

question.value: What mechanism produces (sub)millimeter polarization in the HL Tau disk, and does the polarization pattern change with wavelength (870 um, 1.3 mm, 3.1 mm)?

evidence.quote: In this paper, we present ALMA polarization observations of HL Tau for two more wavelengths: 870 $\mu$m and 1.3 mm.
With the ALMA Cycle 4 program 2016.1.00162.S (PI: I. Stephens)

findings_qualitative.value: 870 um polarization is uniform and parallel to the minor axis (consistent with self-scattering); 3.1 mm azimuthal; 1.3 mm a mix

evidence.quote: For 870 $\mu$m, the polarization morphology is extremely uniform and parallel with the minor axis of the disk.

claims.hypothesis: The dominant polarization mechanism in HL Tau changes with wavelength
claims.experiment: ALMA polarimetry at 870 um, 1.3 mm, and re-imaged 3.1 mm
claims.result: Uniform minor-axis pattern at 870 um, azimuthal at 3.1 mm, superposition at 1.3 mm

evidence.quote: this paper provides definitive evidence that the dominant (sub)millimeter polarization mechanism transitions with wavelength.

claims.hypothesis: The 1.3 mm pattern is a transition between scattering and radiation-anisotropy alignment
claims.experiment: 50–50 mix model and scattering model with aligned grains
claims.finding: 1.3 mm can plausibly be explained by direct emission plus scattering by aligned grains

evidence.loc: 1.3 mm Morphological Model of HL Tau
evidence.quote: This model is not unique and does not match all details of the data

claims.hypothesis: Grains are settled and disk is non-axisymmetric
claims.experiment: Measure P asymmetry along major and minor axes at 870 um
claims.result: Asymmetry along major axis, none along minor axis
claims.finding: Large grains settled into thin layer; disk not perfectly axisymmetric (tentative)

evidence.quote: We also find tentative evidence that the linear polarization fraction $P$ is asymmetric along the major axis of the disk

alternatives_considered_or_rejected.value: Toroidal magnetic field alignment is not consistent with observations

evidence.quote: These observations are not consistent with polarized emission from grains aligned with a toroidal magnetic field.

limitations_admitted.value: Stokes V detection may be spurious and not discussed

evidence.quote: Stokes $V$ has not been well characterized for ALMA, so its detection could be spurious and will not be discussed in detail in this paper.
